title: 第二十九章 第一笔大钱
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
槐荫坡这天很热闹。

    热闹得老槐树上的小鬼都不习惯。

    先是梁家派人送尾款。

    来的不是梁二叔的人，是梁氏身边那个老管家。老管家穿着素衣，手里捧着匣子，进门就规规矩矩行礼。

    “沈姑娘，夫人说，梁家案还没全结，二爷也还在缉违堂问着。可答应姑娘的尾款不能拖。”

    沈清萝接过匣子，先开盖数钱。

    阿青飘在旁边，小声：“好歹客气一下啊。”

    沈清萝头也不抬：“客气容易数错。”

    老管家愣了一下，反倒笑了。

    “夫人还说，姑娘这样就很好。”

    老管家还带来一封梁氏亲笔信。

    信不长，字写得有些颤。

    梁氏说，梁正德和春桃的魂证已经由问魂堂接收，梁家族老也不敢再把长房当死人屋子看。她会守住副账，守住梁正德留下的铺子，也会替春桃在后院立一盏小灯。

    信末只有一句话。

    “从前我总等别人救我。如今知道，手里有账，脚下才有路。”

    沈清萝看完，把信折好。

    “梁夫人学得挺快。”

    阿青轻声道：“她本来就不笨，是被吓久了。”

    沈清萝嗯了一声。

    匣子里有尾款，还有另一个小袋。

    沈清萝掂了掂。

    “多了。”

    老管家道：“那是夫人替大爷和春桃补的香火。夫人说，不是封口钱，是活人欠死人的。”

    沈清萝把尾款留下，又把小袋打开看了看。

    数额不小。

    她沉默片刻，只取了其中一半。

    “这份给梁正德和春桃置安魂香，另一半拿回去。”

    老管家忙道：“夫人说都给姑娘。”

    “她现在要用钱的地方多。”

    沈清萝把小袋系好，推回去。

    “梁家那群族老不是吃素的。她手里有钱，腰才硬。告诉她，她不欠我。”

    老管家眼睛有些红。

    “是。”

    第二拨来的是玄司的人。

    送的是乱葬沟临时协查预付款，还有旧义庄封存补贴。

    数额不大，手续特别多。

    沈清萝看完三张文书，忍不住道：“玄司给钱这么慢，收罚金也这么慢吗？”

    送文书的役吏咳了一声。

    燕不归没来，只让他带了一句话。

    “燕捕头说，钱会补，旧档他会查。叫沈姑娘别自己去撬玄司库门。”

    沈清萝挑眉：“我撬库门做什么，里头又没我的钱。”

    役吏被噎了一下，又从怀里拿出一小包铜钱。

    “这是燕捕头私人补的，说是旧义庄那几个小魂的头七香火。他说不入公账，免得你嫌玄司流程慢。”

    沈清萝掂了掂钱袋。

    “燕不归还挺上道。”

    阿青：“你前面还说人家没钥匙。”
content_en:
Huaiyinpo is very lively today.

It was so lively that even the kid on the old locust tree was not used to it.

First, the Liang family sent someone to deliver the final payment.

The person who came was not Uncle Liang, but the old housekeeper next to Mr. Liang.The old housekeeper was wearing plain clothes and holding a box in his hand. He bowed politely when he entered the door.

"Miss Shen, Madam said that the Liang family case has not been settled yet, and the second master is still asking questions in the anti-violation hall. But I promise that the girl cannot delay the final payment."

Shen Qingluo took the box and opened the lid first to count the money.

Ah Qing floated beside him and whispered: "At least be polite."

Shen Qingluo didn't even raise her head: "It's easy to make mistakes if you're polite."

The old housekeeper was stunned for a moment and then smiled.

"The madam also said that it's good for the girl to be like this."

The old housekeeper also brought a letter written by Liang.

The letter is not long, and the handwriting is a bit shaky.

Mrs. Liang said that the soul certificates of Liang Zhengde and Chuntao had been received by Wenhun Hall, and the Liang family members no longer dared to regard the eldest room as a room for the dead.She will keep the assistant account and the shop left by Liang Zhengde, and she will also set up a small lamp in the backyard for Chuntao.

There is only one sentence at the end of the letter.

"In the past, I always waited for others to save me. Now I know that only when I have an account in my hand, I will have a path at my feet."

Shen Qingluo read it and folded the letter.

"Mrs. Liang learns very quickly."

Ah Qing said softly: "She is not stupid to begin with. She has been frightened for a long time."

Shen Qingluo hummed.

The box contains the remaining balance and another pouch.

Shen Qingluo weighed it.

"More."

The old housekeeper said: "That's the incense that Madam made for the uncle and Chuntao. Madam said that it's not the sealing money, it's something that the living owes the dead."

Shen Qingluo kept the balance and opened the pouch to look at it.

The amount is not small.

She was silent for a moment and took only half of it.

"Give this part to Liang Zhengde and Chuntao to buy requiem incense, and take the other half back."

The old housekeeper said hurriedly: "Madam said everything should be given to the girl."

"She has a lot to spend her money on now."

Shen Qingluo tied the pouch and pushed it back.

"The Liang family is not a vegetarian. She has money in her hands and a strong waist. Tell her that she doesn't owe me."

The old housekeeper's eyes were a little red.

"Yes."

The second call came from Xuan Si.

The gift was an advance payment for temporary assistance in the investigation of mass graves and a subsidy for the sealing of the old village.

The amount is not large, but there are a lot of procedures.

Shen Qingluo read the three documents and couldn't help but said: "Xuansi is so slow in giving money, is he so slow in collecting fines?"

The clerk delivering the documents coughed.

Yan Bugui didn't come, so he only asked him to bring a few words.

"Captain Yan said that he would make up for the money and check the old files. Tell Miss Shen not to pry into Treasurer Xuan's door by yourself."

Shen Qingluo raised her eyebrows: "Why should I break open the warehouse door? There is no money of mine inside."

The servant choked and took out a small bag of copper coins from his arms.

"This was done by Yan Baotou privately. He said it was the first seven incense fires of the little souls from the old Yizhuang. He said it would not be included in the public accounts, lest you think Xuansi's process is slow."

Shen Qingluo weighed her money bag.

"Yan Buhui is still on the road."

Ah Qing: "You said before that I don't have the key."
